definitions.explanation: payment calculated and typically paid on a per-day basis

examples.japanese: {日給|にっきゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1{万|まん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧です。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日給|にっきゅう}⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Is this part-time job paid on a daily basis?

examples.japanese: {日給|にっきゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: Since I'm paid daily, my income decreases when I take days off.

notes:
{日給|にっきゅう} refers to wages paid on a daily basis, common for part-time or temporary work.

WRITING:
- ⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧ (day)
- {給|きゅう} (salary, wage)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日給|にっきゅう}⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧ (daily wage system)
- {日給|にっきゅう}⟦{月給|げっきゅう}{制|せい}→月給制：28589_gekkyuusei⟧ (daily rate paid monthly)
- {日給|にっきゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (to pay daily)

RELATED WAGE TYPES:
- ⟦{時給|じきゅう}→時給：04693_jikyuu⟧ (hourly wage)
- ⟦{月給|げっきゅう}→月給：04692_gekkyuu⟧ (monthly salary)
- ⟦{年俸|ねんぽう}→年俸：19672_nenpou⟧ (annual salary)
- ⟦{週給|しゅうきゅう}→週給：28590_shuukyuu⟧ (weekly wage)

USAGE:
- Common for construction workers, event staff, temporary jobs
- Often seen in job listings as "{日給|にっきゅう}○○⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧"
